detail.longDescription: 🐳 Docker multi-stage build tip: If your production container still includes a compiler toolchain (gcc, cargo, pip wheel build deps), you are carrying unnecessary attack surface and 500MB of dead image weight. Separate your build stage from the runtime stage and deploy on minimal distroless or Alpine base images. Smaller images mean faster pull times and zero unnecessary binaries. # docker # devops # containers # sysadmin # foss # security
